data.name: Terminal Closure
data.detailed_description:
Terminal Closure is a space warfare simulator. In the near future, the Federation of Inner Planets and the Confederation of Moons came into conflict over control of the resources of the outer planets.

Key Features

  • TECHNOLOGIES - Every weapons and equipment, laser, railguns, missiles or engines, were designed based on realistic data and theories, providing the simulation with maximum realism.

  • PHYSICS AND ORBITAL MECHANICS – Every aspect of the ship's systems, energy consumption, weapon range, heat generation, is based on physics.  The trajectory of missiles and projectiles is subject to the gravity of celestial bodies, just as ships must obey the laws of orbital mechanics.

  • CAMPAIGN - Take on the role of a tactical station officer and fight in a fratricidal war for control of the solar system, involving the moons of Jupiter and Saturn and the asteroids in the Belt. Make tactical decisions, monitor your ship's resources, and force the enemy to surrender.

Your ship is made up of several modules, each with specific functions. If the reactor is damaged, you won't have enough power to power your weapons, If the engine is destroyed, the ship will no longer be able to maneuver. If you lose the radiators, the ship will slowly burn up in the cold of space.

data.short_description: Take your place at the tactical station of a spaceship and face a brutal war in the near future for control of the outer planets in this realistic space warfare simulator. Choose your side and lead your ship into battle, maneuvering and fighting according to the laws of orbital mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / NVIDIA GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or equivalent, compatible OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550 / Intel Iris Xe or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
